description: Adaptive placement / cold-start: a tree-walk that locates a new student's mastery frontier in O(log n) probes, with an abstract probe interface and an IM3 problem-bank reference implementation. Track 5 of the Knowledge Space Engine Alignment program (kst-srs.v2 Improvement Plan Item 5). Depends on Track 1.
deviation_notes: 3 extra tasks from regression hardening (invalid probe result handling, non-finite masteryEstimate rejection, Phase 5 final verification). Known gap: PlacementResult -> getKnowledgeState integration test blocked on Track 1 (wire-kst-pipeline).
